Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning sales and use tax exemptions for prescribed power wheelchairs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales and use tax exemptions for prescribedpower wheelchairs; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary in RCW82.08.0283, the tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales ofpower wheelchairs and the related accessories and services asprescribed by a person licensed under the laws of this state toprescribe such equipment. (2) For the purposes of this section and section 2 of this act,"power wheelchair" means a chairlike battery powered mobility devicefor people with difficulty walking due to illness or disability, withan integrated, modular or custom seating system, electronic steering,and four or more wheel nonhighway construction. "Power wheelchair"does not include a "vehicle" or a "motorized foot scooter" as definedin chapter 46.04 RCW.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary in RCW82.12.0277, the provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect tothe use of power wheelchairs and the related accessories and servicesas prescribed by a person licensed under the laws of this state toprescribe such equipment. (2) "Power wheelchair" has the same meaning as provided in section1 of this act.
